ma.reportLog(Object object)

a developer-defined log reporting interface (minimum version: 23.12.0)

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
level String info No Log type. The value can be debug, info, or error.
log Object / String Yes If the log is an object, JSON is required.

Usage Restrictions

  1. To use this interface, you need to connect to the Mini Program SaaS platform

Sample Code

ma.reportLog({
  level: 'info',
  log: 'errMsg'
});
